label: Content format
Format du contenu
help: JSON is parsed strictly and keeps structure. Text is never automatically interpreted as JSON.

label: Replacement action
Action de remplacement
help: Mask uses a fixed marker. Remove omits selected JSON fields. Pseudonyms require a wallet key.

label: JSON field names
Noms de champs JSON
help: Case-insensitive exact names at any depth. This does not detect every kind of private data.

label: Mask recognizable email addresses
Masquer les adresses email reconnues
help: Bounded ASCII email pattern, not universal address or personal-data detection.

label: Mask text
Texte de masquage
help: Literal replacement marker, never a secret.

label: Pseudonym key reference
Référence de clé des pseudonymes
help: Wallet reference only, required for pseudonymize. The key is never included in the output or report.

label: Exact text to mask
Textes exacts à masquer
help: Up to 32 literal strings, no regex. Do not store credentials here; select credential fields instead.

label: Input size limit (bytes)
Limite de taille (octets)
help: Reject an oversized document before processing; no partial result.

label: Maximum replacements
Nombre maximal de remplacements
help: Bound matching work across the whole document. Exceeding the limit fails without emitting original data.
